newsitem.title: USA: IXC to issue $100 mln in preferred.
newsitem.headline: IXC to issue $100 mln in preferred.

text.p: IXC Communications Inc said on Thursday it has agreed to issue $100 million of preferred stock to Morgan Stanley Capital Partners and the Trustees of the General Electric Pension Trust.
The new series A seven percent convertible preferred stock will allow the company to complete a previously announced 7,000 mile fiber expansion and provide additional operating capital, IXC said.
IXC said Morgan Stanley Capital Partners will be acquiring 75 percent and General Electric Pension Trust will be acquiring 25 percent of the new Series A Stock.
The issuance, which is subject to the expiration of the applicable waiting periods under Hart-Scott-Rodino, is expected to close in March, 1997, IXC said.
Conversion terms of the stock offering were not immediately available.
As of the end of the company's fourth quarter, the company had approximately 25 million shares outstanding.
